messages:
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary rollout 'fast-rollout' at svc-inference-prod started 2026-02-10T14:02:03Z. Observed spike in 5xx rate on canary cohort (p50 latency ~ 220ms -> p50 900ms, 5xx rate 7.8%). Auto-abort criteria set to 5% triggered.
alex: saw this alert, paging in. 5xx spike across fast-rollout group?
maria: yes, looks concentrated on canaries in us-east-1. prod-stats dashboard -> https://internal/redwood/dashboards/canary-fast-rollout shows error ratio and trace sampler.
sam: grabbing logs from the canary instances now. tailing /var/log/inference/requests.log on canary nodes.
jordan: oncall runbook says if abort criteria triggered -> flip kill-switch flag, then rollback or redirect traffic. linking runbook: https://internal/runbooks/canary-failures
emily: @alex can you verify customer-impact? any external errors being seen in external-monitoring? statuspage shows degraded for 1 endpoint (text-gen-stream).
alex: external incidents: a handful of 500s coming from a few enterprise tenants, rate is low but customers hitting streaming endpoints might see failed streams. Customer-success pinged.
oncall-bot: PAGE: eng-oncall escalation -> primary oncall: alex, escalation in 2m if no ack.
alex: ack. I'm on it. @deploy-bot can we pause traffic to canary cohort now?
deploy-bot: ACTION: paused traffic to canary cohort (fast-rollout=canary) at 2026-02-10T14:04:18Z.
maria: thank you. I'm still seeing KV cache evictions and long tail latencies in canary telemetry, maybe memory pressure or quantized OOMs?
sam: logs show repeated "rpc timeout" and a handful of `out_of_memory` traces around model inference step. grep results: ```2026-02-10T14:03:45Z ERROR runtime:oom: model_worker=wk-42 ctx=token-gen```
jordan: if OOMs, maybe the quantized config for this model variant was incorrectly applied to canaries. Was there a config override in the rollout?
emily: yes, the rollout included a config patch that enables q8 quantization for speed. canary instances got the new artifact. Could be incompatibility with batch sizing.
alex: decision: engage kill-switch (disable fast-rollout flag), then start rollback of canary artifact to previous stable image. @deploy-bot initiate kill-switch and rollback, coordinate with oncall-sre.
deploy-bot: ACTION: kill-switch engaged (feature flag fast-rollout set to OFF) at 2026-02-10T14:06:03Z. Reverting canary config to stable image version v2.14.1.
maria: starting controlled drain on canary nodes, initiating `kubectl cordon` + `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets` to help pods stop accepting new streams.
sam: pulling heap and GPU memory metrics, there's a memory cliff at ~3m after startup for the q8 worker process. I'll attach traces to ticket.
jordan: initiating rollback job: `deployctl rollback svc-inference-prod --to v2.14.1 --scope canary` (logs: https://internal/deploy/logs/4150000123).
oncall-bot: INCIDENT: Page created -> INC-2026-022-19. Severity: P2. Links: https://incidents/internal/INC-2026-022-19
emily: customer-success updated customers impacted list: three enterprise customers intermittently affected; no major data loss, mostly retries return success.
alex: we're going to monitor error rate for 15m post-rollback. If stable, will unpause traffic and close. If not, escalate to platform.
maria: rollback job completed on canaries at 14:08:50Z, all canary pods now running v2.14.1.
sam: GPU memory graphs show no more cliff post-rollback. 5xx rate back near baseline on canaries.
deploy-bot: ACTION: unpaused traffic to canary cohort at 2026-02-10T14:11:05Z (traffic kept at 10% for observation).
alex: monitoring: p50/p95 latencies decreasing; 5xx now 0.7%. continuing 15m watch. @emily please confirm customers are ok to be notified with postmortem.
emily: Customer-success prefers a short blurb: 'We briefly saw increased 5xx on streaming endpoints for a small subset of customers during a canary rollout. The change has been reverted and services are stable.' I'll draft and send once incident closed.
oncall-bot: HANDOFF: primary alex -> next oncall jordan at 2026-02-10T14:20:00Z. Please review remediation steps and postmortem checklist.
jordan: acknowledged handoff. I'll take next 1hr watch and coordinate postmortem write-up.
alex: quick notes for postmortem: root cause likely quantization + batch-size interaction causing memory cliff on canary config; gaps: rollout gating didn't validate memory behavior; mitigation: tighten canary resource limits + add memory OOM alert to pre-checks.
maria: also propose adding a preflight job to run a short synthetic load test for any model binary/quant flag changes.
sam: saving logs and traces to INC-2026-022-19 artifacts.
emily: sending customer notif in 30m unless further regressions.
deply-bot: NOTE: rollback succeeded, flagged as manual rollback by alex.
jordan: thanks team. I'll kick off postmortem template and assign owners for action items.
emily: :thumbsup:
